title: contracts/e2e.json
description: The app's end-to-end facts: which builds may be tested, the network policy the runtime sampler proves, the devices, the screenshot matrix, folders of flows run by hand, and testIDs that are not in contracts/screens.json. Read by scripts/e2e/ and by the e2e-maestro skill's check-flows, check-e2e-setup and check-e2e-report.

productionAppIds.description: The store app ids (iOS bundle id, Android package). A build with one of them is the production variant: it has no test-only code and no debug link, so the runner refuses it.

buildExtra.description: Values the build's embedded expo.extra must hold, or the runner and the capture refuse the build. An app with react-native-google-mobile-ads sets { "adsMode": "off" } (admob-ads-and-consent's ADS_MODE=off build: no consent form, no tracking prompt, no ad sockets; ads flows run by hand in a manual folder). An app without ads removes the key.

devicePrefix.description: Devices are named <devicePrefix>-<purpose> (tasks-e2e-phone). Default: contracts/ios-sim-build.json simulatorPrefix, else the package name in kebab case.

maestroBin.description: The Maestro binary. Default tools/maestro/bin/maestro (scripts/e2e/install-maestro.sh puts the pinned version there).

ios.description: Simulator models and where the Release simulator build lands.

appPath.description: The folder that holds the .app. Default build/ios-sim/dd/Build/Products/Release-iphonesimulator (ios-simulator-build).

android.description: The Android virtual devices: the system image they are created from, their hardware profiles and the release APK.

apkPath.description: Default build/android-emu/app-preview.apk (android-emulator-build keeps each variant's Release APK there, because the next clean prebuild deletes android/; pass --app-path for an EAS artifact).

network.description: What the runtime socket sampler proves: offline-only (no socket to another host at all), allowlist (only allowHosts), or off (no runtime proof; needs why).

allowHosts.description: The hosts the test build may reach (allowlist mode): the API host, a crash or analytics host when the test build enables it.

why.description: Why there is no runtime network proof (mode off).

largeText.description: The locales the a11y flows run in at the largest text size: one left-to-right and, when the app has one, one right-to-left locale.

screenshots.description: The screenshot matrix: every device x light/dark x locale, captured by the matrix flow.

platforms.description: The platforms whose baselines check-e2e-setup --baselines requires. Default ios and android.

manualFolders.description: Folders of .maestro/ that hold flows the runner never lists (production SDK behaviour, real system prompts, store sandboxes). check-flows still checks them. Declare each in contracts/naming.json extraE2eFolders too.

startsOutside.description: The app is started outside Maestro (xcrun simctl launch <udid> <id> / adb -s <serial> shell monkey -p <id> 1) because launchApp grants every permission and would hide the system prompt under test: its flows never call launchApp.

requiredParams.description: Debug-link parameters the folder's first setup link must set (a consent geography, a store environment).

tags.description: Flow tags besides smoke, journeys, offline, rtl, a11y, quarantine and screenshots.

extraTestIDs.description: testIDs a flow may use that contracts/screens.json does not list (test-only screens, probes), each with why. check-flows fails any other unknown id.
